notes:
Top lines: building an IDE copilot shipped to enterprise customers w/ strong reproducibility needs. Primary ask = model/version pinning for code completion so regression-free rollouts; need deterministic outputs across releases (seed+tokenizer+quant profile pinned).

CTO quote: "We cannot push updates that change autocompletions for committed code paths — reproducibility is non-negotiable."

Requirements summary:
- Workload: interactive code completion (single-turn and streaming multi-token completions), in-editor suggestions, occasional larger refactors via chat.
- Throughput & latency: target median token stream latency <40ms for in-editor completions, cold-start for model <250ms, concurrent dev sessions ~150, peak qps ~200.
- Reproducibility: ability to pin model binary + tokenizer + quantization profile + compiler/kernels. Replayable evals with seeded generation and deterministic KG across hosts.
- Rollouts: need staged canaries (1% internal -> 10% beta -> 50% org -> 100%) with automatic rollback on eval gate failures.
- Eval gates: automated regression checks against curated prompt set (repo+internal tests) and metric thresholds (exact-match rate, compile-success rate, hallucination delta).
- Routing: prefer Dedicated in US-West for latency; fallback to hosted variants only if Dedicated capacity degraded; require policy-driven fallback with explicit log of version differences.
- Security: VPC/private control plane for IP protection; SAML SSO; strict audit logs; KMS integration for model keys; retention controls for prompts.
- Cost sensitivity: willing to pay premium for reproducibility & latency, but ask Redwood Optimize recommendations to reduce token cost without impacting determinism.
